The rule that a shown result closes the work, and that the person's eye is never the gate on an ordinary delivery, explicitly carves this out: it changes nothing about rule 12's own ground, and an action that is genuinely irreversible outside git still stops for his word before it runs, never only after it is shown. Green suite, passing publish checklist and a written changelog make the artifacts ready; readiness is not permission.
